Folks —

Infra perspective on the proposed staged reserve: 
- Lead time: to provision and validate a dedicated pool (NVIDIA H100-equivalent) we need ~4 weeks from PO + cleared capacity ticket. If they want 30% available immediately on go-live, we need a firm start date and the PO signed before 11/20 to have baseline capacity by mid-December.
- Risk windows: Dec 20—Jan 3 is constrained because of vendor maintenance and holiday provisioning limits. If Acme expects aggressive ramp during that window, we should either offer burst credits instead of guaranteed dedicated capacity for that period or include an SLA footnote.
- Operational ask: we need a runway for canary traffic and an opt-in KV cache warmup window (2 days) to avoid latency regressions on new model variants.

I updated the reserve-ask sheet with two provisioning scenarios (fast-track vs standard) and added a note on the maintenance window. See attachment.
